source.rulesVersion: 2024 baseline unless active entry says otherwise

compendium.summary: Fixed-location stored spell and trigger planning.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Component planning: Prep, traps, spell batteries, lair defense. Expensive; do not spam casually.
Pre-cast gate: Fix the legal location, trigger, stored effect, cost, and movement restriction.
Failure state: The glyph is moved, discovered, dispelled, triggered by the wrong creature, or never matters.
Safe operating default: Build for one known defensive objective and document the trigger in plain language.
